beats: Five things missing from a rich man's house. None of them are money.
Your house is full. Theirs is empty. Same species. Different wiring.
Number five. No TV. The wall is the art.
No clutter on the counters. Your kitchen is a storage unit. For a famine that never came.
The fridge is empty. Scarcity hoards. Abundance doesn't have to.
No visible logos. A logo tells other people. They don't need to tell.
Nobody's home. It isn't a house. It's where the money sits.
You spent years filling a room. They sell it in an afternoon. Same room.
In my cave, nothing. And nothing cost me nothing. Which room in your house is a museum of fear? Pick yours below.
